'''Senate-grade ionic disruptors''' were anti-[[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Disruptor/Legends|disruptors]] used by [[Judicial/Legends|Judicials]] near the end of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Droids could be designed to resist their charges, however.
